title: Kissed French Indian Lentils Gulab Jamun
description: A briny, velvety lentil dessert that blends French lentils with Indian spices, steamed to perfection in bamboo and soaked in a fragrant syrup.
instructions: Rinse 100 g French lentils until water runs clear.
Cook lentils in 200 ml water until soft, about 15 minutes, then drain excess moisture.
Mash cooked lentils with a fork or blender to a smooth paste, adding almond milk gradually to reach a thick consistency.
Stir in 50 g flour, 5 g baking powder, 1 g salt, 1 g turmeric, 1 g ginger, 0.5 g cinnamon, and 0.5 g cardamom until a cohesive dough forms.
Let the dough rest for 10 minutes to allow the flour to absorb moisture.
Shape the dough into 12 small round balls, smoothing the surface.
Place the balls in a preheated bamboo steamer lined with parchment, and steam for 20 minutes over simmering water.
While steaming, prepare syrup by heating 150 g sugar, 100 ml water, and 5 ml lemon juice in a saucepan until sugar dissolves.
Add 1/4 tsp cardamom powder to the syrup and simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Once the lentil balls are steamed, transfer them immediately into the warm syrup and let soak for 10 minutes.
Remove the balls from the syrup and serve warm, garnished with fresh mint leaves if desired.
